description.zh: 收集、压缩并富集火星大气 CO₂，以 g-C₃N₄ 基光催化体系制甲醇。拟通过元素掺杂与异质结构改善可见光利用、载流子分离和选择性。
description.en: Martian atmospheric CO₂ is collected, compressed and enriched for methanol production using a proposed g-C₃N₄ photocatalyst. Doping and heterostructures aim to improve visible-light utilization, carrier separation and selectivity.

description.zh: 连接上游 CO₂ 光催化与下游生物制造的液体碳源和能量中间体。
description.en: A liquid carbon and energy intermediate linking CO₂ photocatalysis to downstream biomanufacturing.

description.zh: 工程毕赤酵母利用甲醇，经中心代谢、MVA 通路与异源 EIZS 合成 EPI；设计通过关键酶、NADPH 和 ATP 调节改善前体及能量供给。蓝光 CRISPRi 提供三种候选策略，抑制竞争代谢或控制 EPI 末步，以协调生长和生产；光衰减模型指导高密度培养中的光照与诱导。防护设计包含细胞内黑色素、营养缺陷、低温响应自杀开关及反应器防尘、紫外过滤、透光和保温。EPI 进入两相发酵的上层有机相，经分离纯化获得产品，萃取相回用。
description.en: Engineered Pichia pastoris converts methanol through central metabolism, the MVA pathway and heterologous EIZS to EPI. Key-enzyme, NADPH and ATP regulation are designed to improve precursor and energy supply. Three candidate blue-light CRISPRi strategies suppress competing metabolism or control the final EPI step to coordinate growth and production; a light attenuation model guides lighting and induction in dense cultures. Protection includes intracellular melanin, auxotrophy, low-temperature-responsive suicide switches, and reactor dust barriers, UV filtering, light transmission and insulation. EPI partitions into the upper organic phase during two-phase fermentation, followed by separation and purification; the extraction phase is recycled.

description.zh: epi-Isozizaene（EPI）是该方案的目标液体燃料，设想用于未来火星飞行平台。
description.en: epi-Isozizaene (EPI) is the target liquid fuel proposed for future Martian aerial platforms.
